name: 挺括有型商务长袖衬衫款
description: 白蓝双色商务衬衫套图版式，挺括领型与通勤场景双线叙事

styleLock.backgroundSystem: porcelain-mist sweep #EFF3F2 for packshot, spec and variant screens, deep spruce display field #22473E for benefit, macro and closing screens, one extended greige studio wall #E4DED4 reserved for the scene screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio light with a front-left key, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5200K neutral white balance for scene work
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain-mist board #EFF3F2 and a smooth deep spruce matte panel #22473E
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and blank chip outlines in copper ochre #A65E3F only, all letterless
styleLock.presentationRules: shirt reads as the same crisp garment across the set: buttoned collar squared, stable hero scale, folds neat and symmetrical
noDrift: no hues beyond #EFF3F2, #22473E, #A65E3F and #1E2422 plus one product-matched greige neutral #E4DED4
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or brush lettering
no random scenic backgrounds or gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast drift
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp business menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain-mist background #EFF3F2, deep spruce display green #22473E, copper ochre accent #A65E3F and ink text #1E2422; bright soft cool studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line letterless icons in copper ochre only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable squared-collar hero scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的正面主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, shirt buttoned on an invisible ghost form, collar squared, the entire shirt in frame from shoulder to hem
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, gentle contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the shirt buttoned on an invisible ghost form with the collar squared and cuffs neat, the entire shirt from shoulder to hem in frame. Bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, a gentle contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless porcelain-mist background #EFF3F2. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no hanger, no model face, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no wrinkled fabric, no cut-off sleeves.

shots.intent: 一秒传达挺括领型与版型的核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at chest height, folded shirt stack with the collar standing up, placed left of center
shots.lighting: soft cool key from the upper left, one crisp highlight along the collar line, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep spruce display field #22473E with one thin copper ochre rule #A65E3F under the headline slot
shots.props: one blank letterless headline bar and one thin copper rule line #A65E3F
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle at chest height, the shirt neatly folded in a stack with the collar standing crisp, placed left of center, occupying 50-60%. Deep spruce background #22473E, one thin copper ochre rule #A65E3F under an empty letterless headline bar, soft cool key light from the upper left. Generous negative space on the right 40% for copy. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented fabric percentages, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the collar.

shots.intent: 放大领口软塌起皱的尴尬，反衬挺括领型
shots.camera: matched split-screen close crop at collar height, identical framing straight-on eye-level on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat dull light emphasizing wrinkles, right panel clean cool key light
shots.background: both panels on porcelain-mist #EFF3F2 divided by one copper ochre hairline #A65E3F
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on close crop framing at collar height. Left panel: a limp wrinkled shirt collar losing its shape under flat dull light. Right panel: {product} with a crisp squared collar under clean cool key light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels on porcelain-mist #EFF3F2 separated by one copper ochre hairline #A65E3F. Each panel carries a blank letterless caption slot. The collar detail occupies 55-60% per panel. No extra whitespace. Negative: no model face, no real brand collars, no fabricated claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入通勤晨间场景，让买家投射自己的生活
shots.camera: eye-level candid 3/4 from the waist up, face cropped out of frame at the jawline
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5200K, gentle shadows on the placket
shots.background: extended greige studio wall #E4DED4 with a softly blurred office-corridor depth
shots.props: one plain letterless notebook held aside, never covering the shirt
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a generic adult model cropped at the jawline, no recognizable face. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level candid 3/4 view from the waist up, adjusting one cuff. Soft morning window light from the left at 5200K with gentle shadows along the placket. Extended greige background #E4DED4 with softly blurred office-corridor depth, one plain letterless notebook held aside, not covering the shirt. The shirt occupies 40-50% of the frame. No extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face or identity, no hands covering the product, no cluttered desk, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用缝线与织物细节证明做工与面料质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the collar seam and top button placket, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft directional side light skimming across the weave, controlled highlight on the stitch line
shots.whitespace: minimal, the stitch detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the collar seam, stitch lines and top button placket. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp. Soft directional side light skimming across the weave with a controlled highlight on the stitching. Matte deep spruce board background #22473E with one thin copper ochre index line #A65E3F as the only graphic. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented thread counts, no fabric percentage labels, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 对比面料拉伸后是否回弹，消除变形疑虑
shots.camera: matched two-panel layout photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, identical framing on both sides
shots.lighting: even flat cool light, identical on both panels
shots.background: left panel porcelain-mist #EFF3F2, right panel copper-washed light field #E4DED4 with a copper ochre header bar #A65E3F
shots.props: one blank letterless result chip under each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout, two matched panels photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down with identical framing and light. Left panel: a shirt cuff stretched out of shape on porcelain-mist #EFF3F2. Right panel: {product} cuff recovering crisp and smooth. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Right panel on a copper-washed light field #E4DED4 with one copper ochre header bar #A65E3F, one blank letterless result chip under each panel. Even flat cool light on both sides. The cuffs occupy 50-60% per panel. No extra whitespace. Negative: no fabricated test data or percentages, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 平铺展示版型并留空尺码表位，消除尺码疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shirt folded square
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: deep spruce field #22473E with a light spec card in porcelain-mist #EFF3F2
shots.props: one structured spec table with generic column headers and blank value cells, thin dimension callout lines with empty end caps in copper ochre #A65E3F
shots.whitespace: structured margins around the spec card, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the shirt folded square. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Deep spruce background #22473E holding one light spec card in porcelain-mist #EFF3F2 with generic column headers and blank value cells, plus thin copper ochre dimension lines #A65E3F with empty end caps. The shirt occupies 45-55% of the frame. Structured margins around the card, no extra whitespace. Negative: no invented size numbers, no unreadable tiny text, no dense body copy, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并排展示两个配色让买家快速选择
shots.camera: straight-on view at chest height, two folded shirts side by side, identical angle and light
shots.lighting: even soft cool studio light, consistent across both variants
shots.background: porcelain-mist field #EFF3F2 with two blank colorway chips outlined in copper ochre #A65E3F
shots.props: two small blank letterless swatch chips under the garments
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product} in two colorways, one light and one deep-toned, folded and placed side by side. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on view at chest height, identical angle and lighting across both variants. Porcelain-mist background #EFF3F2 with two blank letterless swatch chips outlined in copper ochre #A65E3F, one ink rule #1E2422 under each chip. The pair occupies 60-70% overall. No extra whitespace. Negative: no texture loss on the dark variant, no lighting drift between variants, no mixed folding styles, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，留空按钮位引导行动

shots.lighting: even soft studio light with one punchier accent edge from the upper right
shots.background: deep spruce closing field #22473E with one blank copper ochre CTA bar #A65E3F
shots.props: one blank letterless CTA button slot and one short empty title bar, both in copper ochre #A65E3F

Straight-on centered hero angle, the shirt front facing with a slightly tighter crop than the main packshot, occupying 55-60%. Deep spruce closing background #22473E, one blank letterless CTA button slot and one short empty title bar in copper ochre #A65E3F, even soft studio light with one accent edge from the upper right. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1『时尚帅气男装』主视觉实拍为白衬衫配领带男模；屏2纯棉品质科普页（棉花实拍图+舒适透气/布料柔和/吸汗性强/特色品质四个圆框图标）；屏3参数页（颜色白色/蓝色、面料99%纯棉面料）与尺码表（S-XXL，行为衣长/袖长/衣领等衬衫量法，数值一律留空）；屏4『万能凹造型神器』文案页+工坊街拍双模特大图；屏5多色可选（黄色/灰色色块胶囊+卖场实拍）与『拉伸不变形/拉伸变形』对比；屏6『不跑绒才是真的暖/5层高密度面料360度防钻绒』；屏7『细节展示/领上精品』双领部特写大图；屏8双模特坐姿大图；屏9鞋部特写+二维码与会员角标。品类判定：源夹名『男装』，但文案自相矛盾（羽绒服/防钻绒 vs 99%纯棉面料），以图为准改判——全部实拍主图均为男士长袖衬衫（白/蓝衬衫配西服），尺码表为衬衫量法（衣长/袖长/衣领），故定为男装/上衣，leaf=男士商务长袖衬衫；羽绒服跑绒与防钻绒主张因与实拍矛盾一律不作事实写入，99%纯棉等数值不搬运。已剥离：模特身份与面容、二维码、会员与促销角标（屏9）、素材站贴片与水印字样（多屏）、原文案原句、具体品牌与价格参数（屏3尺码/价格行留空）、卖场实拍中的第三方品牌商品。与近似模版差异：①同品类已有 suite-gangfeng-gezikuan-chenshan（纸米白#F6F1E6/青灰蓝/墨炭/赤陶橙暖调）与 suite-nanzhuang-jinzhahuang-wangge-chenshan（金盏黄#F1AC1E暖调格纹），本件另起冷调瓷雾白#EFF3F2+云杉墨绿#22473E+赤铜赭#A65E3F全新色板，四色经全库查重均未出现；②背景体系弃用两家格纹衬衫的字母纸板/全幅黄色印花场，改为瓷雾白平铺场+墨绿展示场+单一暖灰场景墙的明暗交替三段式；③道具弃用画布背包、样衣人台与衣架，改用空白规格卡（空表格单元）、铜赭空尺寸线与空按钮位，全部letterless；④机位体系新增『高45度俯视双栏对比』与『墨绿板上织缝微距』，角色序列为HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>COMPARISON>DETAIL>VARIANT>CTA，与库内衬衫件的角色序列均不同；⑤与近邻 suite-nanzhuang-xuexi-qianlan-xiushen-niuziku（雪白#FDFDFB/暖燕麦，牛仔裤）、suite-nanzhuang-yuanglingyinhua-duanxiutxu（暖灰室内+篮球道具）在色板、道具与背景上均无重叠。
